# Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (wrong number or error)
- [ ] New feature (measure, backend, generator, analysis)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Release preparation

## Evidence

How were the expected values in the tests obtained (hand calculation, closed
form, another package, bit for bit comparison)? Does the change affect stored
results or random number streams?

## Verification

```text
# commands and results
```

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and reviewable
- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] Help pages, vignettes and the capability matrix are updated if needed
- [ ] NEWS.md updated for user-facing changes
- [ ] No run directories, `.Rcheck` output, tarballs or caches are committed
- [ ] The pull request follows the Code of Conduct
